import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, x, y, s):
        x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.int64)
        y = np.asarray(y, dtype=np.float64)
        assert x.shape == (3,)
        assert y.shape == (3,)
        assert np.ndim(s) == 0
        # a = 2.5 x
        self.a = 2.5 * x
        # b = x s
        self.b = x * s
        # c = x ⋅ y
        self.c = np.dot((x).ravel(), (y).ravel())
        # d = x ∘ y
        self.d = np.multiply(x, y)
        # e = x × y
        self.e = np.cross(x, y)
